recipes.name: CHICKEN BREASTS
instructions: Remove the wings: Spread each wing wide, slice through the skin to the joint, break it open, and separate. - 3 ½ 1b chicken
Remove the spring: With kitchen shears, cut along each side of the spine to remove. Set aside for stock-making. - 3 ½ 1b chicken
Spatchcock: Make a small cut along the breastbone to crack it open. This makes it easier to break down the bird. - 3 ½ 1b chicken
Thigh and drumstick: Slice down along the breast to remove thigh and drumstick as one piece. Separate the drumstick from the thigh by cutting through the joint. - 3 ½ 1b chicken
Halve the breasts: Press your knife down the breastbone to cut the breast in half. You should have two bone-in, skin-on chicken breasts. - 3 ½ 1b chicken
Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper - 3 ½ 1b chicken - kosher salt to taste - black pepper to taste
Add oil to the skillet and heat over medium high heat. - 2 tbsp virgin olive oil
Place the chicken breasts skin-side down in the skillet and sear until the skin is golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes. - 3 ½ 1b chicken
Flip the chicken and transfer the skillet to the oven for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 160°F - 3 ½ 1b chicken
Return the skillet to medium heat and add shallots. Cook until soft and fragrant. - 1 medium shallot finely chopped
Pour in sherry or wine, scraping up the brown bits. - ¼ cup sherry or white wine
Add chicken stock, thyme, and sage, reducing until syrupy. - ½ cup chicken stock - 1 tsp fresh thyme - 1 tsp fresh sage
Add butter, melting into the sauce, and finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice. - 2 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp lemon juice
Serve: Slice the chicken breast against the grain into medallions, keeping the crispy skin intact and arrange the chicken on a plate, pouring over the pan sauce.
